arguments.code:
# Compute oldest released song across union of song, album, and playlist libraries

# Login for spotify access token
creds = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
username = apis.supervisor.show_profile()['email']
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username=username, password=creds['spotify'])['access_token']

page_limit = 20

# Fetch song library (all pages)
song_library=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    song_library.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

song_ids_songlib = {s['song_id'] for s in song_library}
print('song_library songs', len(song_library), 'unique_ids', len(song_ids_songlib))

# Fetch album library (all pages)
alb_library=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    alb_library.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

album_song_ids=set()
for a in alb_library:
    for sid in (a.get('song_ids') or []):
        album_song_ids.add(sid)
print('album_library albums', len(alb_library), 'unique song_ids', len(album_song_ids))

# Fetch playlist library (all pages)
pl_library=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    pl_library.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

playlist_song_ids=set()
for p in pl_library:
    for sid in (p.get('song_ids') or []):
        playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
print('playlist_library playlists', len(pl_library), 'unique song_ids', len(playlist_song_ids))

all_song_ids = sorted(song_ids_songlib | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids)
print('union unique song_ids', len(all_song_ids))
print('min/max song_id', all_song_ids[0], all_song_ids[-1])
